title.text: Block graph past 6–7 blocks: today and two options, on one real 15-block plan

facts.text:
What the real plan says

15 blocks, 46 block-to-block edges, 140 connections.

Five blocks (Paper & Charcoal, Sludge, Bio Plastic/Resin, Metals, Ores) are the source of 34 of the 46 edges.

Today's layout puts 11 edges right-to-left, because Sciences lands in column 0. Reordering by fewest back edges leaves 6.

Icons are not drawn here; blocks and items are named.
